# CYBERSPEC

> A cyberpunk theme for ui-sdk (https://ui-sdk.dev): 70 components and 7 screens with cut-corner frames, glitch and scan effects that respect reduced motion, synthesized interface sounds, and a visible signal when an agent changes something. Plain CSS, React, installable from a shadcn registry.

Every control is a ui-sdk component underneath (`@ui-sdk/react`, `@ui-sdk/core`), so keyboard behavior, ARIA and the ui-sdk agent bridge come with it.

## Install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest registry add @cyberspec=https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/{name}.json
npx shadcn@latest add @cyberspec/cyber @cyberspec/button @cyberspec/slider
```

Any item also installs from its URL: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/panel.json`. Every item depends on `cyber`, which adds the `<Cyber>` root, the foundation stylesheets, the fonts and the page-wide behaviors.

```tsx
import { Cyber } from "@/components/ui/cyber"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function App() {
  return (
    <Cyber>
      <Button tone="primary">Deploy</Button>
    </Cyber>
  )
}
```

## Rules when building with it

- Wrap the app, or the part that should look like this, in `<Cyber>`. Styles are scoped to `[data-skin="cyber"]` and sit in cascade layers (`cyber.*`), so unlayered app CSS wins.
- `<Cyber accent={{ l, c, h }}>` sets the accent (OKLCH). `fx="full" | "calm" | "off"` pins the effects level; left out, it follows the person's choice and `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Shape comes from `data-frame` (`"tr bl"`, `"notch br"`, `"spine br"`), configured with `--frame-cut`, `--frame-line`, `--frame-fill`. Don't set `border-color`, `clip-path` or `background-image` on a framed element, and don't round anything.
- Colors are tokens (`--cy-accent`, `--cy-ink`, `--cy-signal`, `--cy-flag`, `--cy-line-ctl`, `--cy-fill-active` ...). Red is the resting color, so errors are yellow (`--cy-flag`) with a glyph and words.
- Effects are tokens too: `animation: var(--cy-fx-in) 200ms var(--cy-ease-snap) both`. They resolve to nothing when effects are off.
- Sound is off until the person turns it on: `setSoundEnabled(true)` from `lib/sound`; `sfx("tick")` plays one.
- Give every control an accessible name. An agent finds controls by those names.

## Agents on the page

The components work with the ui-sdk agent bridge (`createAgent` from `@ui-sdk/react/agent`): an agent can `snapshot()` the page, `query()` choices and `act()` on components by label. The kit adds a visible signal: whatever an agent changes lights cyan for a moment (`data-agent-touch`) and is announced to screen readers. Mark anything irreversible with `data-agent-confirm="<what it does>"` so an agent has to ask a person; `data-agent-hidden` and `data-agent-secret` keep regions and values from it.

## The skin

- [Cyber](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/cyber.json): Sets a project up for the cyberspec kit: the <Cyber> root, the foundation stylesheets (tokens, the cut-corner frame system, effects, shared field and popup looks), the fonts, and the page-wide behaviors the components rely on (the FX level, synthesized interface sounds, haptics, keyboard-or-pointer focus tracking, and the signal shown when an agent changes something).

## Components

- [Accordion](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/accordion.json): Stacked sections that open from numbered headings, each with a glyph that turns.
- [Alert dialog](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/alert-dialog.json): A flagged confirmation that has to be answered, and that an agent has to ask a person about.
- [Alert](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/alert.json): An inline notice on a spined frame: info, success, warning or danger, each with its own glyph.
- [Avatar](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/avatar.json): A portrait in a cut frame, with initials over a generated scanline field when there's no image.
- [Badge](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/badge.json): A small cut label in seven tones, with count and status variants.
- [Breadcrumb](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/breadcrumb.json): A trail of pages, the current one in the signal color.
- [Button group](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/button-group.json): Keys joined in one strip, horizontal or vertical, with hold-to-repeat.
- [Button](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/button.json): A key on a display: a cut frame with a raised tab, in five tones, that flashes as it's pressed.
- [Calendar](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/calendar.json): A month grid with today marked and the chosen day lit.
- [Card](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/card.json): A content card with a scanlined media slot, plain or interactive.
- [Carousel](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/carousel.json): A viewer: slides in a cut frame, with keys, segment indicators and a position readout.
- [Checkbox](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/checkbox.json): A cut box that fills and marks when checked, with an indeterminate state.
- [Choice list](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/choice-list.json): Replies to choose from: rows in the signal color, the chosen one a solid yellow bar.
- [Code block](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/code-block.json): Highlighted code with line numbers, a filename tab and a copy key. No highlighting dependency.
- [Collapsible](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/collapsible.json): One section behind a key that shows and hides it.
- [Combobox](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/combobox.json): A text control that filters a list of options as you type.
- [Command palette](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/command-palette.json): A searchable list of commands behind a prompt, in a dialog.
- [Context menu](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/context-menu.json): An area that opens a menu on right-click, a long press, or the keyboard.
- [Data table](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/data-table.json): Rows with selection, sortable columns, status badges and a menu per row.
- [Date picker](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/date-picker.json): A date field with a calendar that opens beside it.
- [Dialog](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/dialog.json): A modal panel on a spined frame that tears in over a dimmed page, with its answers on keys below.
- [Drawer](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/drawer.json): A sheet that slides in from the edge of the page, and can be dragged.
- [Feed](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/feed.json): Dated events in order on a vertical rule: who did what, and when.
- [Fieldset](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/fieldset.json): A spined frame grouping several fields under a legend.
- [Glitch text](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/glitch-text.json): Text that decodes itself into place and tears for a moment, with a stable copy for screen readers.
- [Hex stat](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/hex-stat.json): An attribute as a hexagon holding an icon, a value and a name, and a honeycomb to lay several out.
- [Holo card](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/holo-card.json): A surface that tilts toward the pointer in 3D, with a sheen and layers at different depths.
- [Hover card](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/hover-card.json): A name that previews a small dossier on hover or focus.
- [Item list](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/item-list.json): An always-visible list of rows in columns, the selected row a solid signal bar.
- [Item slot](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/item-slot.json): A gear slot: a cut tile with a rarity spine, mod sockets, a count and an empty state.
- [Key hint](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/key-hint.json): An input hint: a key glyph and what it does, optionally pressable.
- [Loader](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/loader.json): A boot screen in miniature: a mark, a thin progress bar, a percentage and a cycling status line.
- [Menu](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/menu.json): A key that opens a menu of actions, with checkable items, groups and a submenu.
- [Menubar](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/menubar.json): A bar of menus with one tab stop.
- [Meter](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/meter.json): A segmented gauge with thresholds that change its tone and print a word.
- [Micro-print](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/micro.json): The printed decoration around frames: micro-print lines, barcodes, rulers, data streams and corner brackets.
- [Navbar](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/navbar.json): A navigation bar with status readouts, page links and trailing content.
- [OTP input](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/otp-input.json): One cut cell per character of a code, with a blinking caret in the active one.
- [Pagination](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/pagination.json): Page keys with previous, next and ellipses, and a position readout.
- [Panel](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/panel.json): The kit's container: a frame with a spine or a title bar, a heading, micro-print and a body.
- [Password input](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/password-input.json): A password field with a key to show or hide it.
- [Popover](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/popover.json): A key that opens a framed surface beside it, with a title, description and body.
- [Progress](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/progress.json): A segmented bar with a percentage readout, and an indeterminate state.
- [Radio group](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/radio-group.json): Options where one is chosen, each with a diamond indicator.
- [Rating](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/rating.json): A level picked from a row of diamond pips.
- [Readout](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/readout.json): A large numeral with a unit and a label that counts to its new value when it changes.
- [Resizable](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/resizable.json): Panels split by a handle that drags or steps with keys.
- [Reticle](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/reticle.json): A lock-on bracket that snaps onto whatever it wraps when hovered, focused or active.
- [Screen](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/screen.json): The chrome every full screen shares: a status strip, the content, and a foot with key hints.
- [Scroll area](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/scroll-area.json): A scrolling region with a thin scrollbar and edge indicators.
- [Segmented control](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/segmented-control.json): A row of segments with an indicator that slides to the choice.
- [Select](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/select.json): A labelled trigger that opens a list of options to choose from.
- [Separator](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/separator.json): A rule with tick marks, plain, labelled or vertical.
- [Side tabs](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/side-tabs.json): Icon keys stacked down the edge, with a panel beside them.
- [Signal graph](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/signal-graph.json): A compact live graph, as a trace or a spectrum, with a text summary.
- [Skeleton](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/skeleton.json): Placeholder lines and blocks for content that's loading.
- [Slider](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/slider.json): A ticked track with a cut thumb and a value readout, single or range.
- [Number stepper](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/stepper.json): A value on a readout between minus and plus keys, with MIN and MAX tags.
- [Switch](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/switch.json): A block that slides across a cut track and lights, with its state printed beside it.
- [Tabs](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/tabs.json): Tabs over panels with a sliding indicator, or as cut keys.
- [Terminal](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/terminal.json): A console log with tagged lines, a prompt with history, and a follow-the-end scroll.
- [Text field](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/text-field.json): A labelled text input in a cut frame, with a hint, an error and an optional icon.
- [Textarea](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/textarea.json): A labelled multi-line input with a character count.
- [Toast](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/toast.json): Keys that raise a notification in each tone.
- [Toaster](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/toaster.json): The page's notification region and a notify() helper.
- [Toggle group](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/toggle-group.json): Toggles that share one value, one or several at a time.
- [Toggle](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/toggle.json): A latching key that stays lit while pressed.
- [Toolbar](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/toolbar.json): Keys, toggles and separators in one bar, moved through with arrow keys.
- [Tooltip](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/tooltip.json): A small cut label that appears on hover or focus.
- [Tree](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/tree.json): A hierarchy with connector lines and branches that open.

## Screens

- [Archive](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/archive.json): A database of people, places and machines, one dossier each.
- [Augments](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/augments.json): Five attributes on a hexagonal lattice, with points to spend and an info panel.
- [Comms](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/comms.json): Contacts, a message thread, and replies to choose from.
- [Daemon](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/daemon.json): An agent console: what the agent sees, what it does, a permission prompt, and undo.
- [Grid](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/grid.json): A generated district map with filters, markers and a route.
- [Jobs](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/jobs.json): A job board: tabs, a list of jobs, objectives to tick off, and the brief.
- [Loadout](https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/loadout.json): Gear slots, a weapon's sheet with its stats, and what's in the pack.

## Examples

One per component, named `<component>-demo`: https://cyberspec.vercel.app/r/button-demo.json
